annotations.title: Favorite a pinball location or Hype Index theme

description: Favorite or unfavorite a pinball location or a Hype Index theme as the member, the same heart as on its page. Give the page link or slug (slug), or the id. Calling twice removes it. For a game or a creator, use kineticist_toggle_favorite. Returns { success, favorited }. Acts on the caller's own Kineticist account (the signed-in member, or the API key owner). Agents that make many calls per task use up a free account's daily allowance quickly.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

id.description: The id, with or without its prefix.

kind.description: A pinball location, or a Hype Index theme.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

slug.description: The page link or its last part, e.g. https://www.kineticist.com/locations/the-lounge.
